person.name: Komalesh D. Patil
person.headline: Software Developer
person.summary: Software Developer with 2+ years of experience building enterprise Angular applications, integrating AI into production financial platforms, and delivering full-stack features with ASP.NET Core.
person.intro: I build Angular applications for FX trading at FinIQ in Pune, and integrate AI into them: RAG pipelines and agentic workflows over trade data, on top of ASP.NET Core APIs and SQL Server.

experience.title: Software Developer
highlights: Designed, developed, and maintained Angular-based FX trading modules, including deal entry, configuration, and inquiry screens, with complex validations and cross-browser compatibility.

Delivered an AI-powered Sales Performance & PnL analytics dashboard using Angular, ASP.NET Core, OpenAI/Claude APIs, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows over 10K+ trade records, cutting manual analysis time significantly.
Migrated legacy .NET forms to Angular-based configuration screens, enabling full CRUD operations and improving page load by ~30%.
Developed and enhanced ASP.NET Core REST API endpoints supporting FX deal booking, inquiry, and lifecycle flows across multiple production modules.
Built the CBSConnectivity service to fetch customer and trade data from client Core Banking Systems, and developed post-trade processing logic passing results to downstream systems.
Used AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Enterprise) to speed up feature delivery and code review across production modules.

experience.title: Engineering Intern
highlights: Built Angular-based FX deal entry screens and MIS dashboards using Chart.js to visualize trade and performance metrics for internal reporting.

projects.name: TraceIQ
projects.description: A full-stack AI debugging tool that ingests a JIRA ticket and codebase context, traces the root cause across code layers with confidence ranking, and exports a structured audit report as PDF. Built internally at FinIQ and used by the engineering team for root-cause analysis on production FX bugs.

projects.name: AI Financial Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: An Angular dashboard integrating an LLM via a RAG pipeline over structured financial data to generate AI-powered observations, demonstrating agentic workflow, prompt engineering, and full-stack integration.

projects.name: Intelligent Housing Recommendation System
projects.description: A personalized housing recommendation platform for immigrants using K-Means clustering and NLP-based sentiment analysis of Google reviews, with map-based visualization.

projects.name: Car Parking Slot Detection
projects.description: Research project published in IJSREM leveraging CNN for automatic parking slot detection using computer vision techniques.

achievements: Final year project: Intelligent Housing Recommendation System

publications.title: Car Parking Slot Detection using Convolutional Neural Networks
